question: In which language was the work of Raja Ram Mohan Roy, 'Gift to Monotheists' originally written?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Persian.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy'**s work, **'Gift to Monotheists',** was originally written in **Persian.**
 
• Persian was a widely used language in India during the** Mughal era** and was the** language of the court.**
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy was a prominent **social reformer **and **scholar **who played a key role in the **Indian Renaissance.**
 
• The work, 'Gift to Monotheists', was a critique of **polytheism **and an argument for the** superiority of monotheistic religions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arabic** is a language primarily associated with** Islam **and is widely used in **religious texts and rituals.**

 
 
• The majority of speakers of the **Semitic language** Arabic are found in the **Arab world.**
 
• It is named after the Arab people and first appeared in the** first century AD.**
 
 
 
• **Bengali** is the language of the Bengali people of** eastern India** and **Bangladesh** and has a rich literary tradition.
 
 
• It is the official language of **West Bengal, Tripura,** and the** Assamese Barak Valley.**
 
 
 
• **Sanskrit** is an ancient language of India and is associated with **Hinduism **and traditional Indian knowledge systems.
 
 
• Following the dispersal of its predecessor languages from the** northwest **during the late Bronze Age, it originated in **South Asia.**
